one_line: Military governor-turned-ruler who established an independent Malwa power centered on Mandu in the early 1400s.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, medium height, solid and well-conditioned build
appearance.face: oval face, wheatish Malwa complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard along the jaw, sharp focused eyes with a calm commanding default expression
appearance.hair: black hair kept short and tidy under a deep blue padded Islamic-style turban (dastar) with a slightly conical wrap and a slender plain steel cap peeking at the front edge
appearance.costume: over a long-sleeved, knee-length quilted war-coat (jaama) of muted deep blue cotton with fine vertical stitching, he wears a sleeveless mail shirt suggested under the fabric, a broad leather belt at the waist holding a small pouch, loose straight trousers in warm beige tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots, and a light off-white cotton shawl folded over one shoulder; the overall cut echoes late Delhi Sultanate Malwa attire with practical military tailoring rather than courtly excess.
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Indo-Turkic cavalry sword (talwar) with a simple steel disc pommel and cross-guard, carried sheathed on his left hip in a dark brown leather scabbard with subtle metal fittings, his gloved right hand often resting on the hilt.

ref_desc: Dilavar Khan Ghuri is a mid-40s Malwa ruler with an oval wheatish face, short black beard, deep blue turban, blue quilted jaama, beige trousers, brown boots, off-white shawl and a sheathed steel-grey talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Dilavar Khan Ghuri: a mid-40s Malwa ruler with an oval wheatish face, sharp eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard along the jaw, wearing a deep blue padded Islamic-style turban with a subtle steel cap edge at the front. His main garment is a knee-length, long-sleeved quilted war-coat (jaama) in muted deep blue cotton with fine vertical stitching and a broad brown leather belt at the waist holding a small pouch. Suggest a thin mail shirt under the jaama with slight texture at the edges, and give him loose straight trousers in warm beige tucked into sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots. A light off-white cotton shawl is folded and draped over his left shoulder for modest dignity. At his left hip hangs his signature weapon: a slightly curved Indo-Turkic cavalry sword (talwar) with a simple steel disc pommel and cross-guard, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard with understated metal fittings, his right gloved hand resting casually on the hilt. Use deep blue, warm beige, off-white, brown leather, and steel grey as the dominant colours, and present him standing in a neutral pose that clearly shows face, turban, jaama, trousers, boots, shawl and talwar from head to toe.
